title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story

entities.name: Paala
entities.description: A young woman of Abzan birth raised among the Mardu who undertakes the Lightning Proving to be accepted as a warrior and is named Paala, clan's aid.

entities.name: Refia
entities.description: Paala's younger sister, who tends manul kittens and wants to take their mother's job.

entities.name: Altan
entities.description: A young Mardu rider who opposes Paala's participation in the Lightning Proving, attacks her, and then accepts her help.

entities.name: Emina
entities.description: A young Mardu candidate who attacks Paala at the summit, and later tells the elders that Paala reached the lightning first.

entities.name: Tersa Lightshatter
entities.description: A Mardu warrior of old who climbed to catch the lightning when there were no rules.

entities.name: Lightning
entities.description: A yearling male manul riding cat that Paala names after winning the proving.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The clan of the steppe that took in Paala's family and holds the Lightning Proving.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan from which Paala's family came; her mother thinks they might welcome them back.

entities.name: Lightning Proving
entities.description: A Mardu trial in which young warriors climb a mountain and capture lightning from a dragonstorm to earn their place.

entities.name: Great Arashin City
entities.description: The Abzan city from which Paala's family left on the caravan.

entities.name: Salt Road
entities.description: The caravan road where Paala's family was attacked.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms that grow more frequent, giving the lightning the Mardu seek.

entities.name: Manul
entities.description: Great riding cats used by the Mardu for high mountain hunts.

events.summary: Paala dreams of the night her family's caravan was attacked and her mother fled with her and the baby Refia.
events.quote: Paala only running, running, running from a danger she didn't understand

events.summary: Paala wakes in the manul tent on the night before the Lightning Proving, teasing with Refia.
events.quote: Paala woke with a gasp, sitting bolt upright in the bedding, sending pillows and kittens flying.

events.summary: Paala remembers how a Mardu hunting party found her family and took them in, and how her mother came to tend their manul kittens.
events.quote: a Mardu hunting party that had been tasked with scouting and following the storm had stumbled across the three of them

events.summary: Paala tells her mother she must complete the Lightning Proving to prove she belongs among the Mardu.
events.quote: I'm doing this. I'm of age now

events.summary: Refia brings Paala a yearling manul for the trial and urges her to catch a big bolt.
The captain begins the proving and Altan accuses Paala of shaming the rite.
events.quote: You shame the proving by your participation.

events.summary: Altan ambushes Paala with a knife in the foothills but his falcon falls in a rockslide and pins his leg.
events.quote: they both went tumbling down the rise.

events.summary: Paala frees Altan from the rocks, saying it is the Mardu thing to do, and agrees to take him to the summit.
events.quote: It's the Mardu thing to do.

events.summary: An archer shoots at Paala, and Paala charges, takes her bow and quiver and sends her away.
events.quote: A hard yank, and it came free.

events.summary: Paala finds a viper nest and marks it with arrows to warn other candidates.
events.quote: marking the spot for whoever followed her.

events.summary: At the summit Emina throws stones at Paala, insisting she can never be Mardu.
Lightning strikes and in a vision of viper-headed lightning Paala offers her hand and seizes a bolt.
events.quote: pulling the snake—seizing the lightning—from the storm.

events.summary: Paala wakes tied to her saddle as Emina, Altan and the archer lead her back toward the band.
events.quote: Her hands were tied to the pommel of her saddle

events.summary: Emina and the elders affirm that Paala reached the lightning first and was kind to her peers.
events.quote: Paala was the first to reach the summit,

events.summary: Paala takes the name Paala, clan's aid, and claims her manul as Lightning.
events.quote: I will be Paala, clan's aid, and here's where I belong.

relations.quote: Paala shot her younger sister a suspicious look.

relations.note: raised among the band and accepted at the end
opposes her place and attacks her
relations.quote: You are arrogant to have come this far where you're not wanted,
A rock struck her in the back of the knee
